title: Prime Minister shares an article reflecting on initiatives building a more circular and competitive textile industry
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared an article written by Shri Giriraj Singh that highlights how initiatives around textile recycling, cleaner production and green technologies are helping build a more circular and competitive textile industry. Shri Modi remarked that sustainability has long been integral to India's ethos and is now shaping the future of our textile sector.
The Prime Minister posted on X:
Sustainability has long been integral to India's ethos. It is now shaping the future of our textile sector.
In this article, Union Minister Shri @girirajsinghbjp highlights how initiatives around textile recycling, cleaner production and green technologies are helping build a more circular and competitive textile industry.
